metadata.description: OloLand's plugin marketplace for Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Codex, and Cursor / Grok Bot. Institutional buy-side underwriting depth on top of Anthropic's finance plugin lineup: deterministic financial engines, 311-factor risk taxonomy (67 diligence categories), forensic QoE primitives, cross-deal learning, and the compliance hooks Anthropic's vertical plugins ship empty.

plugins.name: ololand-dd
plugins.description: Institutional due diligence for M&A and private equity — deterministic DCF / LBO / Monte Carlo / real-options engines, a 311-factor risk taxonomy (67 diligence categories) with SaaS, healthcare, real-estate and industrial overlays, forensic QoE, cross-document reconciliation (CPA > tax > management > AI), war-game simulation, assumption controls that gate IC approval, deal and portfolio cockpit reads, virtual deal-team briefings, diligence-request tracking, acquisition-financing prep, company discovery and watchlists, IC-package dispatch, external-artifact grading, and a regulator-grade audit trail with replay. Three sub-agents (dd-analyst, forensic-screener, war-game-strategist). A firm's reviewed corrections and recorded outcomes feed that firm's later risk analysis.

plugins.name: ololand-compliance-hooks
plugins.description: Drop-in compliance, citation, and provenance hooks for Anthropic's Claude Cowork finance plugins. PreToolUse MNPI guard, PostToolUse citation enforcer, local provenance/audit ledgers, tier-capacity warning, and evidence-quality warning for OloLand's IC approval gate. Server-side MCP rail auditing remains authoritative. Populates the empty hooks/ scaffold Anthropic's finance verticals ship with.

plugins.name: ololand-forensic-qoe
plugins.description: Forensic Quality-of-Earnings primitives as a standalone plugin: Beneish M-Score, Benford's Law, EBITDA bridge, journal-entry testing, lapping detection, working-capital deep dive, and sourced covenant, cross-default, and MAC/MAE clause analysis. The Pre-LOI Forensic Screen — IC-defensible, included in Pro and above along with the Full QoE report, vs Big-4 QoE at $150-500K / 4-8 weeks.

plugins.name: cim-generator
plugins.description: 14-section CIM generator with provenance — sell-side memorandums built from your reconciled deal data (financial snapshots, risk insights, market research), not LLM prose. View, edit, and export the finished CIM (PDF, DOCX, PPTX) from the deal workspace.
